Select exact IC50 activity rows for the specified assay CHEMBL333. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical_smiles. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL333 and standard_type IC50. Require non-null canonical_smiles and at least one of pubmed_id or doi. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
